records.title: Study to Assess Safety, Efficacy and Persistence of ACE1831, in Subjects With IgG4-Related Disease
A 52-week Study of Rilzabrutinib Efficacy and Safety Compared to Placebo in Adults Diagnosed With IgG4-related Disease

evidence.claim: ClinicalTrials.gov lists NCT07061938 as RECRUITING (Phase 1/Phase 2, sponsor Acepodia Biotech, Inc.) with U.S. sites in Atlanta, Georgia and Boston, Massachusetts.

ClinicalTrials.gov lists NCT07190196 as RECRUITING (Phase 3, sponsor Sanofi) with U.S. sites in Fontana, California; Sacramento, California; San Jose, California; Tustin, California; and Margate, Florida.
